newsitem.title: CHINA: Stamp-fancier HK thief wore tights against bites.
newsitem.headline: Stamp-fancier HK thief wore tights against bites.

text.p: Police detected several odd things about burglar Yeung Tung-san.
First, he ignored traditional booty in household raids, stealing only stamps because he was a collector.
Then there were two pairs of women's panty-hose tights he wore to protect himself from mosquito bites as he ransacked an unoccupied home, a Hong Kong court heard on Monday.
Yeung, 21, who admitted burglary, was found with 31 stamps and two first-day covers, prized collector items. He also had a reserve supply of two pairs of tights in case of need.
Yeung's lawyer said he hads turned to crime because of hunger.
Judge Richard Hawkes sentenced him to 15 months in jail to run concurrently on two offences -- burglary and being an illegal migrant from China.
